Notes : (1) Based on the experimental work of Loudon (1952), the expression given by Kozeny

(1927) is the best when compared those given by Hazen (1892), Terzaghi (1922) &
Rose (1950),

(2) The range of k values estimated by Kenney et al (1984) and Sherard et al (1984a) are
fairly similar and would be very useful for a rough estimate of k.

(3) Other theoretical expressions for estimating permeability of granular soils are also
available such as that proposed by Silveira & Peixoto (1975). However, these
expressions are too complicated for routine use.
